text: NewRez LLC took over management of my mortgage from XXXX XXXX XXXX in XXXX of XXXX. I had auto debit set up with XXXX from the start and never had any problems. The auto debit process transferred to NewRez LLC with no problems and remained that way ever since. Then on XX/XX/XXXX NewRez LLC has sent an email notification that I am delinquent on my monthly mortgage payment of {$1000.00}. They followed up with a USPS letter received XX/XX/XXXX. I sent an email on XX/XX/XXXX requesting clarifications on the delinquent payment notification. I have never received a reply. I have continually tried to call them via the phone number they provide ( XXXX ) and I get the error message " your call can not be completed at this time, please try again later ''. In the meantime, they continue to take money from my account to cover my mortgage. This feels like a scam and I'm questioning the legitimacy of this company. Are they attempting to pad their revenue with bogus collections?
